fixedPriorReviewFinding: recoveryTask now returns the actual operation result when no onSuccess callback is supplied; discard success is reported accurately.
review: Recovery always opens a NEW unsaved copy only after explicit acknowledgement and a fresh exact-version read; source note id/revision remain provenance and cannot enter the Save request as an existing target.
Saved-notebook fallback is explicit and visible before Save; raw fields/type retained where supported.
Client Save/input/editor generation guards and notebook confirmation admission retained; late recovery-open reads require unchanged editor/input ownership.
Durable queue holds one active write and one coalesced latest snapshot, retires owned ids before removal, closes a disposed connection after already-owned queue work.
Conditional cleanup of a recovered parent uses its displayed version, preserving a newer other-tab row; connection-local retirement is not a durable global tombstone.
Storage refusal/corruption remains secondary status; explicit server Save stays available, with no captured source execution or automatic replay.
Workspace UUID creation uses separate Notes store key and existing serialized handler, preserves existing Notes state and rejects invalid stored scope without rewriting it.
The only new public module route is exact Notes draft-recovery.mjs; existing host/origin/token/content-type and private-source route boundaries remain unchanged.
scopeLimits: Source review and lightweight byte metadata only; no imports/execution of app/module/tests/browser, no builds or syntax checks.
Authored tests are independently reviewed by root, not self-certified by this source peer.
No browser persistence, runtime reliability, feature parity or superiority acceptance before actual hosted evidence.
